clue.text: I'm upset with anger that's more apparent than real

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset turns the piece over so it reads from the bottom up

parts.note: I'm written without its apostrophe gives the letters IM
anger is rage

explanation.surface: Someone's display of fury is more show than substance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' seems to belong to the angry picture, but in this down clue it is the signal to turn the first piece over; 'with' links.
explanation.definitionFit: An optical illusion such as water seen in a desert is something seeming rather than actually existing.

clue.text: State of the French merchandise

parts.note: in French, 'of the' (feminine) is de la
wares are goods for sale, merchandise

explanation.surface: A remark on the condition of goods sold in France.
explanation.definitionFit: Delaware is one of the fifty US states, on the east coast.

clue.text: After take-off, fly past

parts.note: reads like an aircraft manoeuvre, but describes someone who has taken off their clothes and then dashes naked past a crowd

explanation.surface: An aeroplane climbs and then makes a low pass over the field.
explanation.definitionFit: To run naked through a public place, for example across a sports pitch, is the sense meant.

clue.text: Member of the police force, if qualified

definitions.text: Member of the police force, if qualified

parts.words: Member of the police force, if qualified
parts.note: a qualified, ranked policeman or policewoman is described, the qualification being the rank held

explanation.surface: A note that a recruit joins the constabulary only after passing the exams.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'if' looks like a condition; the clue simply describes a constable who has earned a rank.
explanation.definitionFit: A policeman or policewoman of any rank is called a police constable or more generally a police official of that type.

clue.text: Food taken from the hand

parts.note: seems to describe finger food, but a hand is also the name for a cluster of these fruits on the stalk

explanation.surface: Something eaten straight from one's fingers.
explanation.definitionFit: This yellow tropical fruit grows in bunches called hands, each fruit being a finger.

clue.text: Agonised about how to identify a complaint

indicators.note: about here means moved around, so the letters of the word before are rearranged

explanation.surface: A patient fretting over how a doctor will name the illness.
explanation.definitionFit: To work out what illness a patient has is the doctor's diagnostic task.

clue.text: There's a fish on the rod, plain enough

parts.note: the pike is a freshwater fish
a staff is a rod or pole

explanation.surface: An angler notices a catch hanging on the line.
explanation.walkthrough: From the idiom 'as plain as a pikestaff', meaning entirely obvious.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'plain as a pikestaff' lets the noun stand for something obvious, a crossword-only shorthand.

clue.text: Swift and quiet in attack

indicators.note: in places the quiet letter inside the word for an attack

parts.note: a raid is an attack
P is piano, the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: A fast, silent assault.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe something moving at great speed.

clue.text: One might aid camper that's collapsed

definitions.text: One might aid camper that's collapsed

indicators.note: collapsed suggests something falling into a heap, so the two words before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A first-aider tends to a camper who has fainted.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambulance medic is exactly the person who helps a casualty who has fallen ill.

clue.text: Mountains in cattle country

definitions.meaning: in the American West, open grazing land for cattle is the ...

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a line of peaks and open grazing land for herds.

clue.text: Cut down when damaged

indicators.note: damaged signals the word before it is broken up and reassembled

explanation.surface: A tree felled when it was harmed.
explanation.definitionFit: Hewn means chopped with an axe, as a felled tree is.

clue.text: Novel craft on the Trent

parts.note: novel means new
an ark is a vessel or craft, like Noah's

explanation.surface: An unusual boat is seen sailing on an English river.
explanation.walkthrough: The Trent is a major river in the English Midlands; the town on it is formally called Newark-on-Trent, so the clue's last words point to it.
explanation.definitionFit: The Nottinghamshire market town's full name, Newark-on-Trent, includes those words.

clue.text: Resort to a lever to provide lift

indicators.note: read as re-sort, to sort again, so the words after it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Advice to use a crowbar when something heavy needs raising.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Resort' looks like 'fall back on', but read as re-sort it rearranges TO A LEVER; 'to provide' links.
explanation.definitionFit: In American usage an elevator is what the British call a lift.

clue.text: Set of clothes awaiting a delivery date

definitions.text: Set of clothes awaiting a delivery date

parts.words: Set of clothes awaiting a delivery date
parts.note: sounds like a parcel order, but describes the outfit prepared for a baby before its birth

explanation.surface: An order of garments waiting to be shipped.
explanation.definitionFit: A layette is the full outfit of clothes and linen gathered for a newborn baby.

clue.text: Tale of love in a decent novel

indicators.note: in places the letter for love inside the rearranged words
novel means new, so the letters of the words before are made new

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, written O

explanation.surface: A romantic story found in a respectable book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' looks like the book but rearranges A DECENT to ANECDTE, with O set inside.
explanation.definitionFit: An anecdote is a short, amusing story or tale.

clue.text: Record broken by the winner

definitions.meaning: to record sound or video on a magnetic strip
the finishing line strip a race winner breasts and breaks

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a recording medium and the finishing strip at the end of a race.

clue.text: One's restricted by a lack of flavour

indicators.note: restricted by means held within, so the first piece sits inside the second

parts.note: lack means need
One is I, and the 's stands for is, giving IS

explanation.surface: Someone is limited by having bland food.
explanation.walkthrough: One's is I + S (one is); this goes inside A NEED.
explanation.definitionFit: Aniseed is a liquorice-like flavouring from the seeds of the anise plant.

clue.text: They may depend on Scotsmen for their money

definitions.text: They may depend on Scotsmen for their money

parts.words: They may depend on Scotsmen for their money
parts.note: suggests dependants of Scots, but depend means hang: pouches hanging from kilts holding cash

explanation.surface: Relatives who rely on Scottish men to support them financially.
explanation.walkthrough: A sporran is the pouch worn hanging at the front of a Scottish kilt.
explanation.definitionFit: These fur or leather pouches hang in front of a kilt and serve as a purse.

clue.text: Love to take part in new survey of Peeping Toms

indicators.note: to take part in puts the love letter inside the rearranged word
new signals the word after it is remade in a fresh order

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, written O

explanation.surface: Romance features in a fresh study of people who spy on others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges SURVEY to VYEURS, and O goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A peeping Tom is someone who secretly watches others, a voyeur.

clue.text: Senior counsel competent enough to approach in stages

parts.note: the lead is the senior barrister in a case
up to a task means capable of it

explanation.surface: A capable top barrister works towards a goal step by step.
explanation.definitionFit: To lead up to something is to work gradually towards it.

clue.text: Canoe shelter

definitions.meaning: a boat made by hollowing out a log
a trench shelter, or the bench shelter beside a sports field

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a hollowed-log boat and a dug trench used for cover.

clue.text: Time to admit pig on a bus?

indicators.note: to admit means to let in, so the first piece contains the second

parts.note: AD, Anno Domini, marks a period of time
a boar is a male pig

explanation.surface: A question whether it's time to let livestock ride public transport.
explanation.definitionFit: A passenger on a bus is said to be on board the vehicle.

clue.text: Get off with a blonde

parts.note: blonde hair is light in colour

explanation.surface: Someone succeeds romantically with a fair-haired person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Get off with' suggests a romance, but 'Get off' is the definition and 'with' links.
explanation.definitionFit: To alight is to step down from a vehicle.

clue.text: Give notice

parts.note: sounds like resigning a job, but a notice is also a critic's write-up of a play or book

explanation.definitionFit: A critic writes a critique of a show, which the theatre world calls a notice.

clue.text: Saw a number ahead of time

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral 500
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Someone spotted a figure before the deadline.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like a verb but is the noun meaning saying; 'ahead of' links.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old saying or proverb.

clue.text: Note house key always is to be returned

parts.note: a semi is a semi-detached house
B is a musical key

indicators.note: to be returned means sent back, so the word for always is read backwards

parts.note: ever means always

explanation.surface: A memo saying a house key must always be given back.
explanation.walkthrough: A semi-detached house shares one wall, a common British home; 'is' links.
explanation.definitionFit: A semibreve is a musical note, the whole note lasting four beats.

clue.text: Take vain steps to provide support

definitions.meaning: a brace or bar in a framework

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to swagger and a structural brace.

clue.text: Michael, the chief financial backer

parts.note: arch means chief, as in archenemy
an angel is an investor in a stage show

explanation.surface: A man named Michael is the main investor.
explanation.definitionFit: Saint Michael is one of the chief angels in Christian tradition.
